tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You recently completed a course on world history and found it very interesting, though you do have some criticisms. The teacher, Professor Brown, has asked for feedback from students to help improve the course. You want to offer some suggestions. Write an email to Professor Brown.
bullets: Express your appreciation for Professor Brown's teaching.
Mention what you found most helpful about the course.
Suggest what aspect of the course could be improved and how.
tasks.subject: Feedback on world history course
